answer: Cost scales with the square of bodies one operator fields, not headcount. Each attestation deposits a plume trace with operator-stable evidence (ASN, jitter, voyage history) into a shared vine graph whose new leaf must cite a foreign attestation. The pool pays an operator with n identities 1/n^2 of an honest share: a solo agent keeps 1.0, a hundred-clone farm 1/10000, forcing a hundred ASNs each with a real six-epoch voyage. Splitting resurfaces as timing correlation; evasion costs full apprenticeship per body. Like smoke: one candle scents a room, five hundred under one hood choke.
